## Decision and intervention

<!-- The practical decision the result will inform, and the change being tested. -->

## Comparison

<!-- The baseline (A) and the treatment (B). For example, `original` against `brief`, or the current skill against a variant. -->

## Tasks

<!-- The task population: what kind of tasks, where they come from, and how they are chosen before any brief exists. -->

## Worker and evaluator

<!-- The agent CLI, model and settings that do the work and write the brief, and how outcomes are judged: a check, a blind pick, a judge. -->

## Sample, stopping rule and primary outcome

<!-- The planned number of pairs, the stopping rule fixed in advance, and the main outcome measure. -->

## Budget

<!-- The time and plan usage you expect to spend, and the limits at which you will stop. -->

## Prior work

<!-- Related studies, and what this adds beyond them. -->

## Publication, rights and owner

<!-- What you plan to publish (an aggregate report, public tasks, outputs), your rights to it, and who owns and runs the experiment. -->
